channel.title: GAMSA shortage alerts
channel.description: Gender-affirming medicines in Australia under a current TGA shortage notice. Rebuilt daily.

item.title: Discontinued (ARTG cancelled): Cyprostat (Cyproterone acetate 50 mg / 100 mg)
item.description: Permanently withdrawn by the sponsor: both strengths (50 mg, ARTG 156921, and 100 mg, ARTG 51450) were cancelled at Bayer's request from 16 June 2023. This is a discontinuation, not a temporary shortage. Patients on Cyprostat need an alternative brand or agent. Not returning. TGA status as checked 5 Nov 2026.

item.title: PBS-listed until 1 May 2027 (was due to end 1 Nov 2026): Zoladex 3.6mg (Goserelin monthly implant)
item.description: Zoladex 3.6 mg was due to leave the PBS on 1 November 2026. On 23 September 2026 AstraZeneca said it will stay on the PBS until 1 May 2027, that PBS prescriptions written by 30 April 2027 can be filled until 1 May 2028, and that the free Zoladex Continuity Program will not go ahead. The TGA shortage record still shows the earlier 1 November 2026 date. Ask the pharmacist for the current position. Triptorelin 3.75 mg (Diphereline) has had no PBS restriction since 1 October 2026, but its listing is not for use in gender dysphoria in minors. Expected return: access change, not a manufacturing shortage. TGA status as checked 5 Nov 2026.
